notes.title: Devlog: Coordinated attack
notes.content: [p][b]Hello![/b][/p][p]I am very excited to share the progress on the command mode for NPC companions. Attack and hold fire commands allow you to set up ambushes with NPC companions and coordinate fire.[/p][p]If things get hot and you are badly hurt, NPC companions will come to the rescue after securing the area.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you very much for watching.[/p][p]Please support me on my Patreon.[/p][p]Stay tuned for more news and updates![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="RsGJV_hn5kE;full"][/previewyoutube]

Furniture is randomly placed based on pre-set layouts.[/p][p]Follow me on social media to stay up to date with the latest updates.[/p][p]Please support me on Patreon.[/p][p]Stay tuned![/p][previewyoutube="iBdV6-laYlY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p]

notes.title: Devlog: Suppressive Fire
notes.content: [p]Hello![/p][p]For the last two weeks, I've been practically drowning in code, refining and deepening the combat system and AI. I am very excited to show you a new mechanic - Suppressive Fire.[/p][p]From a tactical point of view, suppressive fire is used to prevent the enemy from shooting at you and to allow for movement to a more advantageous position. When bullets fly past a character or hit close enough to them, the character's suppression level begins to rise. The higher the suppression level, the slower the character moves and the worse they shoot. For the player's character, being suppressed worsens the range and radius of their field of view. When a character's suppression level rises above a critical point, the character cannot stand up and can only move while crouching.[/p][p]The enemies have become significantly smarter and more dangerous. Now they can:[/p][list][*][p]Find and use cover.[/p][/*][*][p]Use suppressive fire, preventing opponents from leaving cover.[/p][/*][*][p]Use tactical navigation - flanking and avoiding enemy line of fire.[/p][/*][*][p]Use grenades and rocket launchers. Explosions increase a character's suppression level much more significantly than bullets.[/p][/*][/list][p]I am very grateful to everyone who is interested in my game. I'm doing my best for you![/p][p]Please support me on my Patreon.[/p][p]Until next time![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="EhX2qb_uPso;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Devlog: Arrest procedure
notes.content:
Hello!
I continue to improve the enemy AI. Now they can try to arrest you if the character has no weapon in his hands and no rifle on his back. Of course, a rocket launcher on your back will also prevent an arrest.:) Sidearm is allowed, but only in a holster. Oh, how I want to add the QuickDraw ability, so that you can escape from such a situation.:) 
Please, write what you think in the comments.

[previewyoutube=OX-NzmY7sLQ;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: New Optics Shooting Mode LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello!

A top-down camera is very good for making tactical decisions. But sometimes it creates a problem with long-range shooting.
I present to you a new shooting mode for weapons with optics. In this mode, the camera "detaches" from the character and allows you to use the sight mounted on the weapon – from iron sights to optical sights. The distance the camera can move away from the player is limited by the weapon's range.
Try it right now. I am very much looking forward to your feedback.
Subscribe to my social networks to stay up to date with news and updates.

Thank you for playing!
[previewyoutube=yNDEQswiK9Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello friends!

I created a special training campaign and a training scenario that teaches the control basics. The training scenario takes us into the distant past and contains a mini game of hide and seek with Nazar's little friend Katerina.
